method: Implements ZeroMQ RFC 32/Z85. Encoding accepts hexadecimal bytes with optional whitespace, requires complete two-digit bytes and a byte count divisible by four, and treats each four-byte group as an unsigned big-endian 32-bit integer. Repeated exact BigInt division by 85 emits five most-significant-first characters from the fixed 85-character alphabet. Decoding accepts only that alphabet, requires a character count divisible by five, accumulates each group in base 85 with BigInt, refuses any value above 4,294,967,295, and emits four big-endian bytes as uppercase hexadecimal. No padding, whitespace stripping during decode, Adobe framing, zero-group compression, encryption, key generation or network operation is performed. The UI is limited to 100,000 input characters. Empty input and unknown conversion modes are refused.
